The person's meetings and recordings.

## Connect accounts

Each person connects their own Zoom account in the Gateway, once, and every app that asks uses it. Apps never see the tokens. [How connecting works](/docs/connect-oauth)

The redirect URI to register, with your Gateway's address (like `apps.example.com`):

```text
https://<your gateway>/connect/zoom/callback
```

A General app with user-managed OAuth; Zoom's granular scope names are the ones listed here.

1. Open [marketplace.zoom.us](https://marketplace.zoom.us/develop/create) and create an OAuth app (also called a client or an integration).
2. Add the redirect URI above.
3. Copy the client ID and client secret. The secret is often shown only once.

Add it to your Gateway. It asks for the client ID and secret:

```bash
everyapp provider add zoom
```

Or add it in **Manage workspace → Providers**.

### Use it in an app

```ts
capabilities: {
  zoom: { access: "read", scopes: ["meetings.read"], why: "What the app does with it." },
},
```

Apps ask for these scope sets:

| Set | Allows | Provider scopes |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `identity` | Zoom account (who you are) | `user:read:user` |
| `meetings.read` | Meetings (read) | `meeting:read:meeting`, `meeting:read:list_meetings` |
| `meetings.write` | Meetings (read, create and change) | `meeting:read:meeting`, `meeting:write:meeting`, `meeting:update:meeting` |
| `recordings.read` | Cloud recordings (read) | `cloud_recording:read:list_user_recordings` |

**Check it worked:** `everyapp provider show zoom` shows the client as set. Then open the account menu → **Connected accounts** → **Connect Zoom**.

Something wrong or missing? [Open an issue](https://github.com/every-app/every-app/issues/new?template=provider-request.yml&title=Provider%20guide%3A%20Zoom).
